ui.keeping.title: The Keeping
ending.light_kept.1: The last crack seals. The light stops pulsing and simply shines.
ending.light_kept.2: Far off, under other pieces of the sky, other lights hold.
ending.light_kept.3: Somewhere above, the Glazier sets one more pane into a new sky.
ending.light_kept.4: The sky broke. The pieces kept us. Now we keep the light.
glazier.open: Mind the edges. Everything I sell has one.
glazier.open.2: Still lit, Kept? Then let us deal.
glazier.open.3: Pieces from other Vitrines. Look closely.
glazier.first: I knew the last Kept here. Same eyes.
glazier.no_glint: Not enough Glint. The dark has plenty.
glazier.no_glint.2: Come back heavier. The dark is generous.
glazier.reroll: Another tray. There are always more cracks.
glazier.reroll.2: Not that tray? I have others.
glazier.reroll.3: Fine. I will reach into another crack.
glazier.fuse: Two alike melt into one. Glass remembers.
glazier.warden_fell: A Warden fell. I heard it three cracks away.
glazier.warden_fell.2: That Warden swallowed much. You spilled it.
glazier.begin: Go. The light is drawing breath.
glazier.begin.2: Go. Keep the light a little longer.
glazier.bought: It suits you. Most things do, briefly.
glazier.bought.2: Carry it well. Its owner could not.
glazier.low_hp: You are cracking, Kept. I can hear it.
glazier.low_hp.2: Careful. You are more crack than glass.
glazier.boss_next: The next crack is the deepest. Mind it.
glazier.boss_next.2: Something large is drinking the light.
biome.biome_market.name: The Moth Market
biome.biome_market.intro: Every lantern was lit for the festival, and not one has gone out.
biome.biome_cloister.name: Vesper Steps
biome.biome_cloister.intro: The bell was mid-swing when the sky fell, and it is still ringing.
biome.biome_vineyard.name: Stillfire Vineyard
biome.biome_vineyard.intro: The fire stopped halfway up the hill, and the grapes above still wait.
class.lantern.name: Lamplighter
class.lantern.desc: Lit the last lantern of the festival. Still holding the pole.
class.bell.name: Chorister
class.bell.desc: Sang the evening hymn as the sky fell. Still holding the note.
class.bell.role: Tolls crowds back, then hits twice.
class.blade.name: Vintner
class.blade.desc: Cut the last grapes as the fire froze. Never put the sickle down.
class.blade.role: Fights up close and heals on kills.
class.blade.passive:
Close kills heal 1 HP,
up to 3 HP per second.
rite.flare_lantern.name: Festival Flare
rite.flare_lantern.desc:
Throw a lantern that bursts for {dmg}.
Leaves fire that Burns and Slows foes.
rite.great_toll.name: Great Toll
rite.great_toll.desc:
Toll a great ring around you for {dmg}.
Foes are knocked back and Slowed.
rite.glass_step.name: Glass Step
rite.glass_step.desc:
Dash through foes for {dmg}, unhurt.
The next 3 hits always crit.
weapon.lantern_bolt.name: Lantern Bolt
weapon.lantern_bolt.desc:
Fires a lantern flame for {dmg}.
It bursts for {dmg2} and Burns foes.
weapon.splinter_shot.name: Sky Splinter
weapon.splinter_shot.desc:
Fires a fast splinter of sky glass
at the nearest foe for {dmg}.
weapon.arc_blade.name: Harvest Sickle
weapon.arc_blade.desc:
Sweeps an arc at the nearest foe
for {dmg}, knocking foes back.
weapon.orbit_shards.name: Glass Halo
weapon.orbit_shards.desc:
{count} glass shards circle close,
dealing {dmg} on contact.
weapon.chain_spark.name: Leaping Wick
weapon.chain_spark.desc:
A spark leaps {jumps} times for {dmg}
each. Hits may Burn foes.
weapon.returning_glaive.name: Homeward Blade
weapon.returning_glaive.desc:
Throws a blade that flies out and back,
hitting each foe both ways for {dmg}.
weapon.tithe_coin.name: Tithe Shard
weapon.tithe_coin.desc:
Flicks a shard for {dmg}. Foes it fells
drop extra Glint.
weapon.echo_bell.name: Hand Bell
weapon.echo_bell.desc:
Rings out around you for {dmg}, knocking
foes back. Echoes once at half power.
memento.coal_locket.name: Coal Locket
memento.coal_locket.flavor: A coal from the hearth at home, still warm inside the clasp.
memento.kindling_jar.name: Kindling Jar
memento.kindling_jar.flavor: Dry twigs saved for the festival bonfire. They want to be lit.
memento.torch_glove.name: Torch Glove
memento.torch_glove.flavor: Scorched through at the palm. Its owner never let go.
memento.ashen_crown.name: Candle Crown
memento.ashen_crown.desc:
Burn stacks up to {stacks} times
on each foe.
memento.ashen_crown.flavor: Worn by the festival queen. Every candle on it still burns.
memento.smolder_boots.name: Smolder Boots
memento.smolder_boots.desc:
Walking leaves embers behind
that Burn foes.
memento.smolder_boots.flavor: Someone ran across the festival coals in these. Twice.
memento.glass_marble.name: Glass Marble
memento.glass_marble.flavor: A child's marble. A little of the sky is trapped inside.
memento.prism_lens.name: Prism Lens
memento.prism_lens.desc:
Every {nth} projectile hits, one splits
into {count} shards at {pct}% damage.
memento.prism_lens.flavor: It breaks one light into many. So did the sky.
memento.shard_pouch.name: Pocket of Sky
memento.shard_pouch.desc:
Projectile weapons fire {projectiles}
more at once.
memento.shard_pouch.flavor: Gathered from the street the night the sky came down.
memento.splinter_comb.name: Splinter Comb
memento.splinter_comb.desc:
Crits fire a shard at another foe
for {pct}% of the hit.
memento.splinter_comb.flavor: Half its teeth are glass now. It still catches.
memento.whetstone.name: Whetstone
memento.whetstone.flavor: Worn thin by a vintner who sharpened every dusk.
memento.duelist_ribbon.name: Duelist Ribbon
memento.duelist_ribbon.desc: Hits on unhurt foes deal {pct}% more.
memento.duelist_ribbon.flavor: Tied on before the first cut, never after.
memento.headsman_hook.name: Pruning Hook
memento.headsman_hook.desc:
Hits fell lesser foes below {pct}% HP.
Wardens are spared.
memento.headsman_hook.flavor: Cut what will not fruit. The vine forgives.
memento.tuning_fork.name: Tuning Fork
memento.tuning_fork.flavor: Struck once for the evening hymn. It has not stopped humming.
memento.rite_chime.name: Prayer Chime
memento.rite_chime.desc:
Rites grant 1 Barrier and +25% Attack
Speed for {duration}s.
memento.rite_chime.flavor: Rung at the start of every rite. The rope is worn to a thread.
memento.iron_thimble.name: Iron Thimble
memento.iron_thimble.flavor: Ten thousand needles pushed against it. None got through.
memento.glass_aegis.name: Chapel Pane
memento.glass_aegis.desc:
+1 Barrier at each Pulse start. Blocks
release a burst for {dmg}.
memento.glass_aegis.flavor: A window from the chapel stair. It took the first blow for us.
memento.collector_pin.name: Collector Pin
memento.collector_pin.desc:
Gathering Glint heals 1 HP,
up to 4 HP per second.
memento.collector_pin.flavor: Pinned to a coat with a hundred pockets of things worth keeping.
memento.dust_hourglass.name: Dust Hourglass
memento.dust_hourglass.desc:
{chance}% of Glint gathered fires a shard
at a foe for {dmg}.
memento.dust_hourglass.flavor: Filled with sky dust instead of sand. It runs a little fast.
memento.lucky_button.name: Lucky Button
memento.lucky_button.flavor: Sewn back on three times. Its owner swore by it.
memento.magpie_tin.name: Magpie Tin
memento.magpie_tin.flavor: Full of bright scraps a child would not trade for anything.
memento.haggler_seal.name: Haggler's Seal
memento.haggler_seal.desc:
Offers cost 10% less.
Rerolls cost 1 Glint less.
memento.haggler_seal.flavor: Pressed into wax at every deal. The wax always favored its owner.
memento.grinding_wheel.name: Grinding Wheel
memento.grinding_wheel.desc:
Each weapon lands a sure crit
every {nth} hits.
memento.grinding_wheel.flavor: It sang as it turned. Every blade in the valley knew the tune.
memento.pyre_bell.name: Pyre Bell
memento.pyre_bell.desc:
Each Burn tick has a 10% chance to leap
to a nearby foe.
memento.pyre_bell.flavor: It rang for the harvest fire. It has not finished ringing.
memento.wick_charm.name: Wick Charm
memento.wick_charm.desc:
When hurt, burst in a fire ring for
{dmg} that Burns. Once every 3s.
memento.wick_charm.flavor: A braided wick tied at the wrist, for luck against the dark.
memento.cracked_mirror.name: Cracked Mirror
memento.cracked_mirror.desc:
Dodging or blocking fires {count} shards
in a ring for {dmg} each.
memento.cracked_mirror.flavor: It showed one face before the sky fell. Now it shows many.
memento.music_box.name: Music Box
memento.music_box.desc:
{chance}% of kills repeat the killing hit
on a foe nearby.
memento.music_box.flavor: Wound for a wedding. It plays the same three bars forever.
memento.folded_letter.name: Folded Letter
memento.folded_letter.flavor: Never sent. The ink still says come home before dark.
memento.echo_shell.name: Echo Shell
memento.echo_shell.flavor: Hold it to your ear and hear the hymn from the steps.
memento.patched_cloak.name: Patched Cloak
memento.patched_cloak.desc:
After 4s unhurt, regain {hp_regen} HP
per second.
memento.patched_cloak.flavor: Every patch is from a different winter. It still keeps the cold out.
memento.ledger_page.name: Ledger Page
memento.ledger_page.desc:
Finish a Pulse unhurt: gain 10 Glint,
plus 3 for each Pulse so far.
memento.ledger_page.flavor: Every debt in the vineyard, in a careful hand. All unpaid.

syn.flame.4:
Foes that die Burning explode,
spreading Burn.
syn.flame.6:
Burning foes are Marked. Every
{interval}s, a fire nova Burns nearby foes.
syn.shard.2:
Projectile kills burst into {count}
small shards.
syn.shard.4:
Shard projectiles break into {count}
fragments when spent.
syn.shard.6:
Every {interval}s, a Glass Lance pierces
the toughest foe in sight.
syn.edge.2:
Close hits deal {pct}% more damage
and push foes back.
syn.edge.4: Crits send a piercing slash forward.
syn.edge.6:
Crits grant Rush: faster attacks and
movement, stacking up to {stacks}.
syn.echo.2:
Area attacks repeat after 0.5s
at 35% damage.
syn.echo.4:
Rites cast again 1s later
at half power.
syn.echo.6:
Every {interval}s, every weapon fires
once more.
syn.ward.2:
+{barrier_max} Barrier: blocks one hit.
Recharges in {barrier_recharge}s.
syn.ward.6:
+2% damage per point of Armor.
While Barrier holds, +{attack_speed_pct}% Attack Speed.
syn.trade.2:
At each Glazier visit, gain 1 Glint
per 8 held, up to 12.
syn.trade.4:
First reroll each visit is free.
The Glazier lays out 1 more offer.
syn.trade.6:
+1% damage per 10 Glint held, max 50%.
+{pickup_radius_pct}% Pickup Range.
affix.volley:
Ends each attack chain with a ring
of shots.
affix.veiled:
Wears a shell that soaks up damage.
It regrows when left alone.
affix.blinking:
Every 6s, blinks to a marked spot near
its prey.
affix.tar_trail:
Leaves dark pools that Slow
whoever steps in.
affix.pulsing:
Every 5s, sends out a shockwave
after a red ring.
affix.bulwark: Shrugs off knockback and small hits.

unlit.swarmer.desc: Comes in clouds, drawn to any light.
unlit.shooter.desc: Keeps its distance and throws from afar.
unlit.tank.desc: Slow and heavy. Shrugs off small hits.
unlit.warden_hound.desc:
Lunges in a chain, then sheds a ring
of shots.
unlit.boss_lantern.desc:
A festival lantern that learned
to swallow light.
unlit.exploder.desc:
Rushes close, fizzes, then bursts.
Fell it first and it fizzles out.
unlit.summoner.desc:
Keeps back and calls Midges
out of the cracks.
unlit.lobber.desc:
Lobs from afar where the ground
begins to darken.
unlit.warden_choir.desc:
Sings fans of shots, blinks close,
and hides inside a shell.
unlit.warden_bulwark.desc:
Slams the ground, trails tar,
and calls Midges as it goes.
unlit.boss_bell.desc:
The bell that would not stop.
Each toll is a ring of glass.
unlit.boss_vine.desc:
The oldest vine, grown wild on
what the fire left.
